outcome.answer: The closest matches are [1], [2], [3], [5], [7], and [9]. [1], [2], and [3] are about low-precision FP4 training for large language models, with [1] focusing on comparative training recipes, [2] on adaptive block scaling to reduce quantization error, and [3] on transposition-invariant block quantization for stable end-to-end FP4 training. [7] addresses distributed training with low-bit activations and gradients to reduce memory and communication, while [9] covers dynamic precision allocation for quantization-aware training. [5] provides a broader comparison of FP and INT formats, including 4-bit cases, but it is not specifically about private devices.
